_readme: The familiar species pool: the ten PF1e Core Rulebook base familiars, schema-matched to
animal_choices.json's species entries (starting-statistics block only). Familiars carry NO
'<n>th-level advancement' block: they never advance on their own chassis -- all scaling is the
master-level table in familiar_master_bonus.json, applied by class_func/familiars.py.
Conventions (same as animal_choices.json): 'ac' records ONLY the natural armor bonus; 'attack'
damage dice carry no Str mod (the stat builder adds it); species keys are lowercase and match
the pf-content 'pf-familiars' compendium Actor names case-insensitively (the module norms both).
Improved familiars are deliberately absent: their alignment/caster-level prerequisites are
unverified, and the v1 ruling (companions ticket 02) scoped v1 to the base list.
Master-facing species perks (+3 Fly for a bat, ...) live in familiar_master_bonus.json, NOT
here: any extra key on a species entry would be folded into the creature's own stat block by
companion_stats.merge_advancement, and the perk belongs to the master.
Sources: d20pfsrd bestiary pages + the wizard Familiar class feature page, fetched 2026-08-12.
